requirements.requirement: All six dice expose exactly the audited face distributions.
Triumph contributes one Success and one preserved Triumph.
Despair contributes one Failure and one preserved Despair.
Success/Failure cancel 1:1; zero net = failure.
Advantage/Threat cancel independently.
Triumph and Despair coexist and do not cancel.
Characteristic 4 + skill 2 => 2 P + 2 A.
Characteristic 2 + skill 4 => 2 P + 2 A.
Skill 0 uses characteristic Ability only.
Boost and Setback are both retained.
Upgrade A when A exists -> P.
Positive upgrade overflow adds A then later promotes it.
Negative upgrade overflow adds D then later promotes it.
Downgrade excess is ignored.
Upgrades apply before downgrades.
Removal applies last and excess removal is ignored.
Opposed difficulty built from opponent higher/lower values.
Competitive tiebreak: Success -> Triumph -> Advantage -> draw.
Skilled assistance combines best eligible characteristic/skill across two characters.
Unskilled assistance can add Boost.
Impossible check requires one Story Point and blocks extra Story Point on that check.
Session starts player points = player count; GM = 1.
Player spend transfers to GM only after action resolution.
GM spend transfers to player only after action resolution.
Same player cannot spend two Story Points on one check.
Player side and GM side may each spend one on same check.
Later Brawn increase changes soak but not stored Wound Threshold.
Later Willpower increase does not change stored Strain Threshold.
Defense defaults melee=0/ranged=0.
Career skill sequential cost 5 x purchased rank.
Non-career adds +5 per purchased rank.
Creation skill rank cannot exceed 2 by normal purchase.
Talent pyramid blocks illegal tier purchase.
Ranked talent effective tier increases each purchase through Tier 5.
Ranked talent stays effective Tier 5 for later ranks.
Side Step is a maneuver; Grenadier is non-ranked; Dual Wielder is once/round.

requirements.requirement: Encumbrance threshold = 5 + Brawn.

Overage >= Brawn removes free maneuver.
Accurate adds Boost equal rating.
Inaccurate adds Setback equal rating.
Cumbersome/Unwieldy increase difficulty by deficiency.
Pierce never reduces effective soak below zero.
Stun bypasses soak; Stun Damage does not.
Linked extra hits capped by rating and each gets base + Success damage.
Sunder can activate on failed attack and changes item condition state.
Initiative sorted Success then Advantage.
PC wins PC/NPC exact tie.
Sorted results become side slots, not fixed actor positions.
Normal turn = one action + one free maneuver.
Second maneuver via 2 strain; max two maneuvers on own turn.
FAQ disengage clears all engagements by default.
Melee base difficulty Average.
Ranged Short/Medium/Long/Extreme = Easy/Average/Hard/Daunting.
Soak applies separately to each hit.
Each uncanceled Success adds 1 damage to a successful hit.
Crit activation requires successful hit that deals damage past soak.
Extra crit activations on same hit add +10 to one roll.
Each existing unresolved Critical adds +10 to new Critical roll.
Defense provider stacking/increase stacking obeys cap 4.
Two-weapon pool uses lower skill/char, higher difficulty +1; secondary hit costs 2 Advantage or Triumph.
Unarmed base Brawn damage, Crit 5, Knockdown, optional strain damage.
Equal WT does not incapacitate; WT+1 does.
PC WT exceeded creates one Critical Injury.
Equal ST does not incapacitate; ST+1 does.
Medicine wound difficulty follows half/over-half/over-threshold states.
Medicine heals wounds by Success, strain by Advantage.
Painkiller sequence 5/4/3/2/1/0.
Social oppose matrix defaults correctly.
Successful social strain action inflicts 1 + Success; failure costs actor 2 strain.
Critical remark costs Triumph or 4 Advantage and inflicts 5 strain.
Motivation modifiers +1/+2 Boost or Setback.

requirements.requirement: Bard / Verse FAQ | A magic user may gain Verse; there is no inherent one-magic-skill limit.
Activate default Heroic Ability with 2+ player Story Points | Exactly 2 points move to GM pool; activation succeeds.
Only 1 player Story Point available | Activation is blocked; no point moves.
Second use in same session without frequency upgrade | Blocked.
Duration expiry | Base effect expires at correct end-of-next-turn boundary.
Ability-point progression | Award progression at configured XP milestones without counting starting XP incorrectly.
Signature Weapon + craftsmanship FAQ | Ancient craftsmanship replaces, not stacks with, existing craftsmanship.
Hard-point reduction from replacement craftsmanship | If capacity falls below installed attachment cost, system requires attachment removal before state is valid.
Archetype | Starting characteristics/XP/threshold formulas are data-driven and reproduce source profile.
Archetype ability | Story Point transfer ability works outside a check and respects once/session.
Conditional archetype rule | Strain-relative effect updates when current strain crosses half-threshold boundary.
Registry | Terrinoth profile adds skills without schema migration or sheet-code edits.
Multiple magic skills | Actor can possess and roll more than one magic skill.
Finesse/Precision | Check characteristic override does not alter melee damage characteristic.
Grapple/Tumble | Mandatory rule has precedence over optional maneuver shortcut.
Attachments | Hard-point totals validate on add/remove/update.
Craftsmanship | Only one craftsmanship is active; replacement recalculates rules.
Capacity loss | Hard-point reduction cannot leave illegal attachment state silently.
Heroic Ability cost | Atomic 2-Story-Point cost.
Heroic Ability timing | Once/session and end-of-next-turn duration are enforced.
Heroic progression | Ability points use earned-XP milestones.
Lesser rune | Adds eligible spell effect while waiving that effect’s normal difficulty increase.
Shard activation | Untrained activation and skilled implement paths are distinguishable.
